svg.text: Figure 1 · Level 1 against level 2, case by case
Every cross-check case run on the level-1 plant and the MuJoCo 3.3.5 model: 22 of 26 outcome classes agree. Each disagreement carries a note explaining it (0 cases
unexplained). A disagreement is a finding about the models, not something to tune away.
A slow leak at 8 degrees with load holding working. Level 1 sags (A4) but stays balanced until the lock. Level 2 is reverse-kneed (CL-05): standing on one leg …
A slow leak at 16 degrees with a 0.16 m CoM offset (above the 0.12 m limit, DQ-011) and load holding working. Level 1 loses balance as its centre-of-pressure …
Load holding fails during a slow leak at 20 degrees, so the walker is lost either way unless the joints outlast the leak; the models differ in which actuator …
A slow leak at 19.5 degrees with load holding working; level 1 locks at about 2.9 s, but its centre-of-pressure limit (A3) and leg sag (A4) have let its CoM drift …

Generated by tools/figures/mujoco_readme.py from the level-2 spec, the cross-check and sizing definitions and their committed results. Synthetic: agreement between two models is not validation against a real machine; no

evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate). Families: CAP Actuator-capacity boundary (outside the operating envelope) (0/1); CAT Fault catalogue (sim/faults.yaml) (8/9); NOM No fault (capability by slope) (6/6); SF-01
Failure search SF-01: Hydraulic supply loss in mid-stride on a slope (edge cases) (6/8); STOP Protective stop on a slope (no fault) (2/2).

g.text: Terms: A01–A04 = item-definition validator rule (A01–A04) · CAP-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case at the actuator-capacity boundary · CAT-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case from the fault catalogue ·

CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CoM = centre of mass · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · MuJoCo =

Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics engine for the level-2 walker model · NOM-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case, no fault (capability by slope) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search)
· STOP-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case, protective stop on a slope with no fault
